save.description: First avoids damage; second avoids capture

effect: Form a 10-40 ft. whirlwind for up to four rounds; cannot slam or threaten. Make two independent Reflex saves. Carried targets take damage each round; flyers may save again to escape. Eject as a free action.
Recharge [[1d3]] rounds. Outside combat restore the charge after this interval.

description.value: Airborne creatures take a -1 penalty on attack and damage rolls against an air elemental.

effect: Airborne attackers take -1 on attacks and damage against this elemental.

description.value: Once every 1d2 rounds, an air elemental shoots out a green arrow towards her opponent within 60 ft. The air elemental must makes a ranged touch attack (+14), if it hits, the attack deals 3d6 points of wind damage and knocks her opponent back 10 ft. (Fortitude save DC 16 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 2nd level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 19).

effect: A hit deals wind damage regardless of the save.
